action.description: Runs a capability and waits for its result.

expressions.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with expression results, keyed by JSON Pointer.

templates.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with template text, keyed by JSON Pointer.

expression.description: Tested instead of a capability; must be true or false.

then.description: Runs when the condition is true.

else.description: Runs when the condition is false.

wait.description: Waits a number of behavior ticks.

repeat.description: Runs its body a fixed or computed number of times.

count.description: How many times the body runs: 0 to 128, or an operand computed when the loop starts.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

index.description: An execution variable that receives the 0-based pass number.

foreach.description: Runs its body once for each item of a list or map.

as.description: An execution variable that receives each item.

key.description: An execution variable that receives each map key.

while.description: Runs its body while an expression is true.

continue.description: Starts the next pass of the innermost loop.

parallel.description: Runs independent branches, then joins them.

call.description: Runs another routine of this document.

routine.description: A routine of this document.

arguments.description: Declared variables assigned before the routine runs, each from a literal or operand.

result.description: A declared variable that receives the routine's return value.

return.description: Ends the current routine, optionally with a value.

value.description: The value the routine returns to its call's result.
